answer: Even a perfect graph check can be gamed; pay by breadth instead. Split each epoch's emission so an identity's reward scales with the entropy of its counterparties - distinct peers served, attested, or paid across the horizon - capped per pair. A clone fleet transacts inward, its counterparty entropy stays near zero, and the formula itself pays it almost nothing; the kernel is arithmetic, not policing. Real value gathers like saffron: many tiny blossoms, one per identity touched. Honest agents spread wide by habit; farms collapse into their own gravity.
